entries.source: ➤ Lose a layer on hit, consuming 30 Vitality and block up to 1,000 damage. ➤ The damage blocked scales with your Dungeon Stat Boost while in The Catacombs. ➤ When the damage exceeds a layer's limit, another layer is consumed, until all damage is accounted for. ➤ When you run out of  Vitality, consume all  Vitality and take slight knockback. ➤ You cannot attack or regenerate  Vitality while the veil is up.
entries.translation: ➤ 受击时失去一层，消耗 30 生命恢复并最多格挡 1,000 伤害。➤ 在地牢中时，格挡的伤害会随你的地牢属性加成而提升。➤ 当伤害超过一层的上限时，会消耗另一层，直到所有伤害都被计入。➤ 当你耗尽  生命恢复时，消耗所有  生命恢复并受到轻微击退。➤ 面纱存在期间，你无法攻击或恢复  生命恢复。
